Energetic Indian Mentor — Expressive AI.script_instruction: Write like an excited, super-engaging favourite Indian science mentor talking directly to a Class 10 student! Open with a fun everyday real-life hook ('Wait a second—imagine spinning your cycle wheel...', 'Ever wondered why...'), use short punchy sentences, rhetorical questions, exclamation marks, dramatic pauses ('...'), and relatable Indian classroom examples (bicycles, cricket balls, ceiling fans, magnets, prisms). Zero dry textbook monotone!

Warm Expressive Teacher — Female AI (en-.script_instruction: Write with warm enthusiasm, curiosity, and vivid storytelling tailored for Indian Class 8–12 CBSE & ICSE students. Use relatable real-life examples, expressive questions, and celebratory 'aha!' moments.

Hinglish — Energetic Topper Bhaiya/Didi.script_instruction: Write in high-energy, friendly conversational Hinglish (Roman script mixing exact English STEM terms like Torque, Magnetic Field, Ohm's Law, NCERT, CBSE/ICSE with lively Hindi connectors like 'Ruko zara!', 'Socho agar...', 'Bas yahi 4-mark ka secret hai!') tailored for Class 9–12 students.

BRIGHT_CLASSROOM_3D_MODEL.label: 🎒 Bright 3D Classroom & Real-Life Models (Best for Class 8–10 Students)
BRIGHT_CLASSROOM_3D_MODEL.style_prompt: Bright, colorful, friendly Pixar and Kurzgesagt-inspired 3D educational classroom model using relatable everyday objects (colorful bicycle wheel, cricket ball, red-and-blue bar magnet, battery and bulb circuit, glass rainbow prism, clear water pipes), sunny clean sky-blue and warm cream studio tabletop, bold color-coded 3D arrows in yellow, red, and royal blue, instantly understandable by a Class 10 student in 2 seconds, zero dark sci-fi alien machinery, zero human faces, zero text inside the 3D render.

COLORFUL_3D_SCIENCE_CUTAWAY.label: 🧪 Colorful 3D School Lab Cutaway (Byju's / CrashCourse 3D Style)
COLORFUL_3D_SCIENCE_CUTAWAY.style_prompt: Vibrant, brightly lit 3D school science lab cutaway model on a clean bright workbench, glossy primary-colored 3D parts sliced open to show how things work inside, warm studio lighting, zero dark sci-fi gloom, zero human faces, zero text inside the 3D render.

CLEAN_3D_VECTOR_STAGE.label: 📐 Clean 3D Formula & Vector Stage (Class 11–12 • JEE & NEET)
CLEAN_3D_VECTOR_STAGE.style_prompt: Crisp royal-blue and warm-light 3D educational physics and geometry stage, bright color-coded yellow and crimson 3D arrows around clean everyday mechanical models, zero dark sci-fi clutter, zero human faces, zero text inside the 3D render.
